heater_text: Three straight makes? He's ON FIRE. Give him the ball!

frost.question: Did anyone look at this season before the test was written?
frost.chip: The whole 2024-25 season was sealed before any test ran; the test ran once, on 219274 shots the system had never seen.

frost.question: You tested several ideas at once. Any of them could pass by luck. Did you raise the bar for that?
frost.chip: Yes, the bar was raised for testing the ideas together. It didn't clear it (p = 1.000).

frost.question: Same rate after makes and misses. That's not 'no hot hand', that's 'couldn't find one'. Which is it?
frost.chip: Couldn't find one. The test can only say 'not shown'; nobody registered a test for 'no effect exists'.

ref_text: Insufficient evidence (INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE). Hot hand: three in a row (2024-25, confirmatory) (CONF-HH). What was tested: In 2024-25, within a player's game, a field-goal attempt is more likely to be made after three straight made field goals than after three straight misses, beyond what within-player-game shuffling produces. Why: not rejected at Holm 0.05; no equivalence test registered. Source: Research's recorded final run, under a custodian exposure receipt; copied here, not recomputed.
frost_reaction: Not shown. That's not the same as wrong, Heater.
